beats.say: Taylor Swift stars as a ghost haunting Colin Farrell and Dakota Johnson.
Patient Zero dropped on 25 September 2026 through Republic Records as part of The Life of a Showgirl: The Encore.
The track topped both the US Billboard Hot 100 and the Canadian Hot 100.
Its music video premiered at the 2026 MTV Video Music Awards on 27 September. The song runs for three minutes and forty-six seconds.
Fans keep hunting for hidden clues in the ghostly couple scenes, fueling the song's three week reign. Which hidden clue did you spot first?
